Bayangkan primary sebagai buku kas utama: Think of the primary as the main cashbook and a replica as a copy following its change log. The primary produces WAL, the sender transmits it, the receiver writes it, storage makes it durable, and replay applies the records to the data copy. Sent describes transmission from the primary, write describes writing in the standby operating system, flush describes durable standby storage, and replay describes applied changes. These positions can differ in one observation. A streaming connection describes the delivery path; it does not establish that a particular transaction is visible to a query.
Streaming replication secara default asy: Streaming replication is asynchronous by default. Under normal local durability assumptions, commit acknowledgement can be sent after local WAL is durable without waiting for a replica. A replica can therefore lag after the application receives success. If the primary is subsequently lost permanently, changes unavailable on the failover candidate may be lost. Replicas also follow deletions and incorrect changes, so they do not replace separate retained backups and restoration.
LSN adalah posisi byte, bukan jam: An LSN is a byte position, not a clock
LSN ditulis seperti 0/1000500 dan menyat: An LSN is written like 0/1000500 and identifies a WAL position. Dataset R defines a target that covers the commit to be read and one curated observation per replica. Differences from flush or replay are measured in bytes. A still has a 256-byte replay gap despite a zero flush gap; B has a 512-byte flush gap and a 1024-byte replay gap. These numbers do not identify seconds or missing payments because WAL sizes and rates depend on the workload.
Perbandingan membutuhkan cluster dan tim: Comparison requires the appropriate cluster and timeline ancestry. After promotion, divergent WAL branches can have larger-looking LSNs while containing different changes; a number alone does not establish containment. The practice comparable_lineage flag is an authored assumption, not a timeline-history inspection. A NULL position means evidence is unavailable, not zero lag. Even zero replay gap answers only for the observed target, not for writes after it.
Durable di replica belum tentu terlihat: Durable on a replica does not imply visibility in an old snapshot
Dengan synchronous standby yang dikonfig: With appropriately configured synchronous standbys, synchronous_commit=on waits for remote flush, remote_write waits for a write with weaker operating-system crash protection, and remote_apply waits for replay on the acknowledging standby. Without synchronous standby configuration, those mode names do not make all replicas wait. Local waits only locally, and off weakens the local durability wait. Waiting for standby acknowledgement also changes latency and availability.
Untuk membaca perubahan sendiri, pilih r: To read your own change, select the correct replica and start the read snapshot after target replay has been established. An older transaction snapshot can still show old state even after replay advances. Time since the last replayed transaction can also increase while the primary is idle, so it is not a catch-up forecast. The lesson SQL only calculates authored positions using a TEMP table; it does not read pg_stat_replication, measure a network, or establish production standby health.

Health check gagal dapat berarti proses: A failed health check can mean process failure, stalled storage, overload, or a failure on one network path. Client A may be unable to reach the primary while client B still writes through an old connection. If each side promotes a replica based on its own timeout, both may accept divergent changes. This is split-brain: a write-authority problem, not simply two powered-on machines. Pertanyaan pertama bukan apakah query me: The first question is not whether a query uses SELECT but what decision depends on its result. An invoice-count dashboard may accept ten-second staleness if the product contract states the bound and displays data time. Confirmation after a payment commit needs read-your-writes so the user does not pay again after seeing pending. A balance used to authorize a debit needs an authoritative source and an atomic write decision. Sending all reads to replicas may reduce some load while violating the last two needs. No universal staleness bound suits every feature.
Dataset C menyebut tiga kontrak: bounded: Dataset C names three contracts: bounded_staleness, read_your_writes, and authoritative. observed_age_seconds is scenario-verified data age against the product bound, not replay_lag automatically converted into the age of every row. max_age_seconds is used only for the first contract. The replica_with_staleness_label result permits bounded old data, not exact equality with the primary. NULL age is unknown and therefore cannot meet the contract even on a healthy replica.

The token must come from a correct protocol; the lesson does not claim a SELECT before COMMIT produces a commit token. A reader checks that the correct replica has replayed at least the target within the appropriate lineage. The check must be followed by a query with a new snapshot on the same endpoint. A load balancer switching to another replica can invalidate the conclusion, as can a Repeatable Read transaction whose snapshot predates target replay.
Jika evidence belum cukup, aplikasi dapa: When evidence is insufficient, the application can wait with a deadline and then read the authoritative primary with a new snapshot, or report that status cannot yet be confirmed. Do not wait indefinitely, invent zero lag from NULL, or interpret replica pending as payment failure. The primary may also be unreachable; fallback is a policy with visible errors, not an availability guarantee. During failover, tokens need checking against new ancestry and potentially lost targets; sleeping a fixed number of seconds cannot repair an unsatisfiable token.

After a COMMIT timeout, reconcile by business identity at the authoritative source. Inspecting a lagging replica and resending as a new operation can duplicate effects. Read-your-writes also differs from global linearizability for every user and failure.
